description: Fetch live free proxies from HProxy's public pool, re-checked around the clock. No key. Returns ip, port, protocols, anonymity, country, city, network, latency and 24h uptime per proxy. Use this when the user wants free proxies to test with; for proxies that must survive a real block, HProxy's paid pools are at https://hproxy.com/pricing.

anonymity.description: Only proxies of exactly this anonymity grade: elite hides both your address and the fact that a proxy is used, anonymous hides your address, transparent passes it on.

country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. 'de'. Omit for every country.

limit.description: How many to return. The full list is thousands; ask for what you need.
